messages:
maya: Quick question — we're planning a rollforward of release/2.3.1 in the 18:00-20:00 UTC change window but several deployers can't push. Who currently has sudo (release-sheriff) in prod? deploy-bot is rejecting attempts.
kevin: Which deployers are failing? list the names so I can double-check perms.
maya: sarah, liam, and dan attempted. Getting this from deploy-bot: 'DENIED: missing MFA + role:release-sheriff'
deploy-bot: [system] deploy attempt blocked by policy. Log: ```json
{"user":"sarah","action":"deploy:press","env":"prod","reason":"missing_role","required":"role:release-sheriff","time":1765234560}
```
tara: Reminder — change window is 18:00-20:00 UTC. Emergency JIT flow exists but policy needs 2 approvers (infra or sec).
maya: This is a planned minor rollforward (bugfix). Don't want to miss the window. Can we temporarily grant release-sheriff to one of the deployers?
infra-oncall: I can approve one grant, but policy requires two approvers. @kevin can you second? When you submit the JIT request include reason + duration.
kevin: I can second. maya, open the JIT with reason '2.3.1 minor bugfix rollforward' and set duration 60m, include the ticket link.
maya: Submitted JIT: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345 — JIT req id 9876. Pinged infra-oncall and kevin for approvals.
deploy-bot: [system] JIT approvals received. Granting role 'release-sheriff' to sarah for 45m. Audit id: a8f3-9876-2026. ```yaml
grant: release-sheriff
user: sarah
duration: 2700
approved_by: [kevin, infra-oncall]
audit: a8f3-9876-2026
```
sarah: Thanks — pressing canary now. I'll watch p50/p95/p99 and error rates.
tara: If canary looks stable, do staged pin and then full roll. Add the temporary elevation to the release notes.
maya: Canary looks good — p99 latency steady, errors unchanged. Rolling to remainder of fleet.
dan: Quick Q — who is responsible for rotating the temp role back? Is auto-revoke enabled?
deploy-bot: [system] Role 'release-sheriff' will auto-revoke at expiry (45m) as this was a JIT grant. Audit saved to s3://redwood-audit/a8f3-9876-2026.json
infra-oncall: I'll close the JIT in the portal and file the post-action checklist. Adding notes to INF-2345. Great coordination. :tada:
maya: Adding release note: '2.3.1 rollforward via canary; temporary JIT grants used (audit a8f3-9876-2026); no regressions observed.' :thumbsup:
